style: abstract hand-drawn line-art icon accent, purple/black brand, minimal, confident, icon-is-the-message

icon_scene.description: Single continuous full-duration scene (0-6s), nothing exits, no blank frames. A minimal rod/hand icon at top-center casts fishing lines down through a hand-drawn wavy water-line divider (y=560). Beat 1: one muted line drops straight down and ends bare below the water (reads as sparse/limited). Beat 2: three more lines fan out at staggered angles, each in bright accent, each landing a small abstract fish/catch glyph at its end with a ripple at the water-crossing point (reads as multiplying opportunity). Beat 3: short label fades in beneath the icon. Beat 4: freeze-hold to 6.0s for a clean cut.

beats.event: line-0 draws down, muted, ends bare below water — reads sparse/limited
line-1 draws (bright accent), ripple at water crossing, catch-1 lands
line-2 draws (bright accent), ripple, catch-2 lands
line-3 draws (bright accent), ripple, catch-3 lands
freeze-hold to end (6.0s) for clean cut
